groups.contract: Shared resolved envelopes preserve admitted leaves but do not silently establish raw shape/support coherence
groups.disposition: All three complete bodies read. ResolvedSolid::new moves admitted CollisionCuboid identity/position/dimensions/three angles and cuboid_envelope reconstructs exactly those leaves; deserialize routes raw envelope fields through from_metres before existence. Shape payloads, support refs and owner identity remain separate aggregate contracts, including annular radius/order/fall and sectional depth/sign. No raw payload is inferred validated by the envelope. RoomIndex from_ordinal uses checked u16 narrowing with original ordinal error, while from_serialized is lossless and makes no collection-membership promise. OpeningProfile height Segmental adds raw spring+rise; arbitrary extremes need admission/actual generated consumer proof, not presumed leaf guarantees. Structural thickness predicate fortified >=1.20 alone accepts infinity, but the actual audit finite checks already read290 apply separately; this predicate is not promoted as standalone admission. Roles/enums/ID declarations contain no additional mutation/arithmetic. Slot/source identity repair remains connected to actual callers, not primitive-width replacement.

groups.contract: Convex topology evaluates orientation/area in widened offset coordinates and re-admits mapped polygons
groups.disposition: Whole production and fixture body read. ArchitecturalPlanPoint admits finite Vec2 and serde repeats admission. Polygon checks >=3, nonzero positive signed area, exact duplicate positions and every point against each oriented boundary edge; no reordering of authored input. cross and offset signed_area use f64 after converting finite f32, avoiding native f32 subtraction/product overflow and preserving tiny nonzero f32 triangles. try_map builds local mapped list then re-runs complete polygon admission. Hull sorts geometrically signed-zero-equal coordinates, removes exact duplicates, handles0/1/2 separately and monotonically pops under len>=2; constructed area path is derived by monotone hull. Fixture cases for concave/clockwise/duplicates/collinear, exact contacts, smallest subnormal triangle, collapsed mapping and large-offset area were fully read, not executed.

groups.contract: Roof tessellation is a native accepted-face consumer with bounded index-loop guards, explicit holes and material-side semantics
groups.disposition: Whole426lines read in two chunks. Empty polygon remove-collinear loop has no find candidate, so its modulo expression is never evaluated; <=3 stops before remove. boundary-notch branch requires exactly2 touches, proving cutout.len>=2 before modulo; corner fallback requires an actual outer/cutout matching point before outer neighbors. Remaining holes are handed to earcut with cumulative vertex starts; triangle indices are dependency-produced, not arbitrary public index buffers. Enclosure explicitly rejects <3 points before polygon0. Residual geo ring nonempty/closed requirement remains actual residual/dependency contract; no empty-ring witness or library semantic clearance by hash. Native normal/cross/distance/UV arithmetic and u32 capacity require accepted face geometry; raw RoofFace currently exposes floats, so zero plane/nonfinite or huge coordinates are not assumed admitted semantic roof. Existing boundary cutouts, opposite interior offset and isolated boundary edges are intentional, not a general polygon XOR defect. Full UV orientation matrix and closed square-with-hole prism fixture read only; closure/winding/area assertions are acceptance descriptions, not passing results.
